notes: Bayview (Keith, Jennings, Ingalls, Newcomb, Oakdale, Palou, Quesada, Revere, Shafter area): a diagonal grid of parallelogram blocks; first residential (diagonal hatching), commercial (black bands), light industrial (cross-hatch) and heavy industrial (grid) blocks. Every block stands alone in street paper; blocks cut by the box edge are seeded where their piece shows. Street-name lettering written in a block's corner (KEITH, JENNINGS, INGALLS, HAWES) pokes into the street and is labelled as part of that block. Stroke (558,3036)-(590,3059) separates the INGALLS 'S' (block 4788) from the corner of block 4761, which it touches. Strokes close gaps in printed outlines where street paper leaked into a hatch cell: (183,2943)-(240,2985) on the NE edge of block 4790; (150,3062)-(170,3076) a 3 px gap at about (160,3070) that had cut the top corner off the block below it; (1062,2900)-(1069,2890) at the west tip of the block whose tip is at about (1077,2880). An ink blot in the street at about (1113,3308) and (1120,3291) (131 and 73 px) is left as street; the tool lists it as a possible missed block only because the smallest seeded piece is a 105 px block tip at (408,2353).
